concept: Review and integration: what practicing, finishing, and routines feel like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of practicing something hard, finishing what you start, and keeping a routine — which is easiest for you, and which is hardest?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'discipline' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
